title: PATTERN Can Be Solved from Memory: Testing Graph Neural Networks on Unseen Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2610.15020v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: PATTERN asks graph neural networks to find a planted subgraph in a new host graph. The hosts change, but the benchmark draws just 100 patterns and reuses them across training and test splits. A lookup that extracts these patterns from the training labels achieves 96.6% class-weighted accuracy on the official test split, above every published result, without fitting a model or consulting the generator. On unseen patterns, the same lookup scores 50.6%. A matcher that also uses the generator reaches 99.2% on the official split. Among five graph networks we retrained, GRASS and PPGT go from the top two on the official split to the bottom two on unseen patterns. Each loses 8.1 percentage points even when familiar and unseen patterns are matched in size. translated_title: PATTERN基准可通过记忆破解：在未见过的模式上测试图神经网络
translated_abstract: PATTERN要求图神经网络在新的宿主图中找到植入的子图。宿主图会变化，但该基准仅抽取了100个模式，并在训练集与测试集中重复使用这些模式。一种从训练标签中提取这些模式的查找方法，在官方测试集上达到了96.6%的类别加权准确率，高于所有已发表的结果，且无需拟合模型或查询生成器。而在未见过的模式上，同样的查找方法仅得50.6%。一个同时利用生成器的匹配器在官方测试集上可达到99.2%。在我们重新训练的五个图神经网络中，GRASS和PPGT从官方测试集上的前两名跌至未见模式上的最后两名：即使熟悉模式与未见模式的规模相匹配，它们仍各自损失8.1个百分点。基于两跳节点统计的逻辑回归在未见模式上的得分高于这五个网络的所有运行结果。对于CKGConv而言，其优势依赖于训练模式：当……
tldr: PATTERN基准因训练与测试重复使用相同的100个模式而可被“记忆”破解——简单的查找表就能超越所有已发表的GNN结果，而重新训练的图神经网络在未见过的模式上性能大幅下滑，说明该基准无法衡量模型的真正泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The PATTERN benchmark can be nearly "solved" by memorizing its 100 reused patterns—a simple lookup table beats all published GNN results—while retrained graph networks drop sharply on unseen patterns, revealing that the benchmark fails to measure true generalization.
